description: One propellant tank barrel section taken from a tolerance stack through inspection capability to production rate. The part is chosen because it exercises all three: a welded assembly with a stack that has to close, a fracture critical weld that has to be inspected, and a long cycle time that sets the line.

part.name: 2219-T87 tank barrel section, welded
part.note: the alloy and the fracture data come from aerospaceMaterials; the pressure vessel sizing from aerospaceStructures

inspection.criticalFlawNote: from a damage tolerance calculation at proof pressure; the thin wall case is the same weld at a reduced thickness, which is where the inspection stops establishing anything

production.note: cycle times in hours per unit; every cost is a fraction of the first unit so the case carries no currency
